changelog: [When to Segment]: added permissive rules to split at internal sentence-final punctuation (?/./!) that closes a complete clause, after quoted/embedded questions ending in '?' before their reporting clause, and after -거든/-는데 when the following clause introduces its own new subject/topic as an independent elaboration — fixes measured under-segmentation cases.

[Never Segment]: replaced sweeping caution with precise, condition-based bans — do not split a causal/result connective when the following span is a fragment lacking a finite verb, do not split inside a clause containing 3+ filler/self-correction repetitions (since no boundary there helps), and do not multiply splits across a short sequential-action chain (under ~15 words) joined by repeated -고 connectives — targets the measured over-segmentation and wrong-boundary cases without banning any connective ending outright.
